title: Added new animation tools to PixelLab
author: Kaninen_Ka9en

comments.author: Kaninen_Ka9en
comments.body:
We have moved animation to animation to the core tools and added new template tools for quicker character + animation generations :)

Link to animation to animation tutorial [https://youtu.be/owkamgYVWAs](https://youtu.be/owkamgYVWAs)

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: If you are promoting a commercial service, please use the self promotion tag.

replies.author: Kaninen_Ka9en
replies.body: You can do "3D" as in other directions :) our templates currently do 8 directions but it does support more

comments.author: IncorrectAddress
comments.body: Looks like there are a few bad animation switches, you can see it in between the feet and the floor, but it's not terrible after a few changes to the frame sets, positions, and some motion blurr it could look much better.

comments.author: Josvdw
comments.body: Could you share a bit more about how this is done? how did you create those animations? are you able to do it from text?

replies.author: Kaninen_Ka9en
replies.body: This is done from a template + description but if you have your own animations you can use them as templates as well :)

replies.author: Josvdw
replies.body: And what if I want to create animations from scratch?

comments.author: dharsto
comments.body: Looks like an interesting tool, your docs need a mobile update though.
